# Repository Topics

Add these topics to your GitHub repository for better discoverability:

## Primary Topics
- `streaming-data`
- `kafka`
- `apache-spark`
- `pyspark`
- `elasticsearch`
- `fraud-detection`

- `kibana`
- `prometheus`

## How to Add Topics

1. Go to your repository on GitHub
2. Click on the gear icon (⚙️) next to "About"
3. In the "Topics" field, add the topics listed above
4. Press Enter after each topic
5. Click "Save changes"

Alternatively, you can use the GitHub CLI:
```bash
gh repo edit CippyCabana1109/mpesa-streaming-pipeline --add-topic streaming-data --add-topic kafka --add-topic apache-spark --add-topic pyspark --add-topic elasticsearch --add-topic fraud-detection --add-topic machine-learning --add-topic anomaly-detection --add-topic real-time-analytics --add-topic data-engineering --add-topic fintech --add-topic kenya --add-topic mpesa --add-topic docker --add-topic ci-cd --add-topic python --add-topic data-pipeline --add-topic scikit-learn --add-topic kibana --add-topic prometheus
```
